Package com.bilt.pos.session

Interface SessionContext

public interface SessionContext
What the POS knows about the checkout that any widget may use: the CheckoutPhase and free-form attributes, alongside the lane identifiers the session was built with. Obtained from ShopperSession.context(); the session owns it, and there is one per session.

The context is mutable and can be updated at any time, from any thread: every call is pure local compute under the session's lock, and nothing reaches a terminal or the platform because of it. It is deliberately small — widget-specific tuning lives on the widget, not here. Writes are refused with IllegalStateException once the session has ended, like basket changes. 


 session.context().phase(CheckoutPhase.TENDERING);
 session.context().attribute("lane-type", "pharmacy");
 session.context().attribute("cashier-assisted", "true");

Readers that need a consistent point-in-time view take a snapshot(); the live accessors each read one field at a time.

  • Method Details

    • phase

      CheckoutPhase phase()
      The current checkout phase; CheckoutPhase.SCANNING until something moves it.

    • phase

      SessionContext phase(CheckoutPhase phase)
      Moves the checkout to the given phase. On a terminal session the session's own transitions around settlement may later override it — see CheckoutPhase.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if phase is null
      IllegalStateException - if the session has ended

    • attribute

      SessionContext attribute(String key, String value)
      Sets a free-form attribute — targeting and policy input for widgets, such as "lane-type" → "pharmacy". Replaces any earlier value under the same key; a null value removes the key, like removeAttribute(String).
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if key is null
      IllegalStateException - if the session has ended
